fields: centre_to_altar cache hit and any_altar preexisting state, selected draft/field path, returned steps
too_late calls with existing local operands/result (only when executed)
farm scan first/evaluated/k and already-computed best/shared/help/risky

logging.fuel_gates: No re-evaluation or new fuel query. Existing fuel gate results are not logged where unavailable without restructuring the evaluated expression; k/evaluated and existing shortcut remain the evidence.

execution.proposed: Use copied existing recorder/tracer harness in isolated provenance workspace, one row at a time, exact source plus original B puppet; cap trace to rounds 0-1, then compare accepted inputs/native round hashes through the actor1 move. Do not interpret any trace after first prefix mismatch.

limits: This is logging-only source preparation; it does not establish a trace result.
The fixed opponent puppet does not adapt to the altered action.
The two original replays have separate B-side recorded scripts; each trace must validate against its own source replay.
The gate result is intentionally omitted if capturing it would require adding/repeating a fuel query or changing a short-circuit.
